record.original_question: Let A be strictly increasing in nite sequence of integers, and denote by An the set of n smallest elements of A. What can be said about the structure of A given that jAn + Anj < Cn holds for any positive integer n and an absolute constant C?

evidence.quote: Sequences with locally small sumsets. (Contributed by V. S os) Let A be strictly increasing in nite sequence of integers, and denote by An the set of n smallest elements of A. What can be said about the structure of A given that jAn + Anj < Cn holds for any positive integer n and an absolute constant C?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A = \{a_1 < a_2 < a_3 < \cdots\}$ be a strictly increasing infinite sequence of integers, and for each positive integer $n$ let $A_n = \{a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n\}$ denote the set of the $n$ smallest elements of $A$. The sumset is defined as $A_n + A_n = \{a_i + a_j : 1 \le i, j \le n\}$. Suppose there exists an absolute constant $C > 0$ such that
$$|A_n + A_n| < C n \qquad \text{for every positive integer } n.$$
Determine the structure of all such sequences $A$. In particular, describe (or characterize) the infinite integer sequences whose initial segments all have linearly bounded sumset.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted search did not return a definitive resolution of this question of V. T. Sós on the structure of infinite integer sequences whose initial segments all have linearly bounded doubling. While general structural results on small sumsets (e.g., Freiman-type theorems) are well-developed, no source confirming a complete characterization in this "local" infinite-sequence setting was located.

status_evidence.title: Effective Results on the Size and Structure of Sumsets
status_evidence.snippet: Results on the size and structure of sumsets, related to Freiman-type theorems.
status_evidence.claim: General structural results on sets with small sumset exist but are not stated to resolve the local/infinite-sequence version asked here.

status_evidence.title: Sumsets and structure (Ruzsa lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of sumset structure theorems including Freiman's theorem.
status_evidence.claim: Standard structure theory addresses finite sets with |A+A| ≤ K|A| but does not give a definitive answer to the local sumset condition on all initial segments.
